annotations.text: Owned = the set ids the server already sends (FigureSetIds). Buying inserts user_clothing rows and re-sends that packet, so Choose Your Looks unlocks the piece with no reload.

catalog_clothing has names and part ids but no price. The store needs price, an optional LTD stock pair (sold / total), and a set-type to derive the tab. Names shown are placeholders for the humanised names we would add.

LTD purchase = one backpack item keyed by the clothing id (a numbered edition). Using it consumes the token and unlocks the set. Until used it is a normal backpack item, so it can be traded or gifted later.
